##### Project general facts

360 Riverside Crescent is a masterpiece of luxury, set amidst a breathtaking development spanning eight million square feet, where serene waterfronts, tranquil lagoons, and lush landscaping converge to create a world of natural splendor. This prestigious tower boasts an exquisite range of one, one-point-five, and two-bedroom apartments, each meticulously crafted to foster a sense of serene well-being, where every detail has been carefully considered to provide a haven of everlasting luxury. With its elegant styling and opulent surroundings, 360 Riverside Crescent redefines the art of refined living, inviting residents to experience a lifestyle of comfort, sophistication, and harmony with nature.

The apartments at 360 Riverside Crescent epitomize elegance, with a thoughtful design that cultivates a sense of relaxed wellbeing, perfectly balanced with lavish surroundings. Every aspect of these residences has been expertly considered, from the refined materials to the precise attention to detail, resulting in an unparalleled living experience. With a range of apartment types to choose from, residents can select the perfect abode to suit their tastes and preferences, each one a masterpiece of sophisticated design and luxurious comfort.

The residences at 360 Riverside Crescent boast modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating a sophisticated and elegant atmosphere, perfect for those seeking a refined and luxurious lifestyle. The equipped kitchens provide the ideal space for culinary creativity, where residents can indulge in their passion for cooking, surrounded by the opulent ambiance of their exquisite homes. Every aspect of 360 Riverside Crescent has been carefully crafted to provide a life of unparalleled luxury and sophistication, where residents can immerse themselves in the beauty and splendor of their surroundings.

##### Location description and benefits

Sobha Hartland 2 is a luxurious community that boasts an impressive array of amenities and attractions, with fifty percent of its territory dedicated to verdant parks and picturesque green walkways. The area is surrounded by European-style boulevards, inviting residents to take leisurely strolls amidst the serene atmosphere, while the proximity to the Ras Al Khor nature reserve offers a unique opportunity to connect with nature and observe exotic birds in their natural habitat. Residents of Sobha Hartland 2 can also indulge in a range of water sports, swimming, and sunbathing on the well-equipped beach, set amidst the stunning backdrop of two blue lagoons and a private promenade.

Sobha Hartland 2 is strategically situated in a prime location, surrounded by Dubai's affluent districts, including Business Bay, Downtown, and Creek Harbour, making it an attractive destination for singles, couples, and families alike. The area is under the patronage of the Sheikh, ensuring a high level of prestige and exclusivity, while the proximity to Dubai's heart provides easy access to a range of premium amenities and services. With its unique blend of natural beauty, luxurious amenities, and prime location, Sobha Hartland 2 is a highly sought-after destination, offering an impressive return on investment potential.

The area surrounding Sobha Hartland 2 is a hub of activity, with a range of on-site international schools, retail, and dining options, providing residents with a unique and convenient living experience. The presence of these amenities, combined with the area's prime location and freehold ownership options, makes Sobha Hartland 2 an attractive destination for both UAE residents and foreign citizens, offering a unique opportunity to own a piece of this luxurious community. With its stunning natural beauty, luxurious amenities, and prime location, Sobha Hartland 2 is a truly unique and desirable destination, perfect for those seeking a life of luxury and sophistication.
